title: Duel Decks: Zendikar vs. Eldrazi: card flavor text

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A world of uneasy ground, unpredictable magic and few safe places, threatened by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Affa
entities.description: Once a welcoming hub for explorers that became a place of guarded tongues and quick defenses.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings that hunger without limit and consume without pause, whose brood lineages spread across the world.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who urges swift action in the war against the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Samila
entities.description: A member of the Murasa Expeditionary House.

entities.name: Murasa Expeditionary House
entities.description: An expeditionary organization to which Samila belongs.

entities.name: Yon Basrel
entities.description: An Oran-Rief survivalist.

entities.name: Oran-Rief
entities.description: A region of Zendikar associated with the survivalist Yon Basrel.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: A phenomenon that redraws the world as it passes, leaving only the hedrons unchanged.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Stone monoliths that remain unchanged by the Roil and began to coalesce into colossal Eldrazi superstructures.

entities.name: Chanter's Epics
entities.description: Never-ending tales recited by adventuring bards to keep their comrades alert to danger.

entities.name: Zurdi
entities.description: A goblin shortcutter.

entities.name: The Invokers' Tales
entities.description: An in-world writing about life on the brink of extinction and the Eldrazi brood lineages.

entities.name: Nikou
entities.description: A Joraga bard.

entities.name: Joraga
entities.description: A people whose bards include Nikou.

entities.name: Nirthu
entities.description: A lone missionary who believes the Eldrazi's purpose has nothing to do with mortals.

entities.name: Ganda
entities.description: A Goma Fada deserter who wonders why the Eldrazi preserve.

entities.name: Goma Fada
entities.description: A group that Ganda deserted.

entities.name: Zahr Gada
entities.description: A Halimar expedition leader who tests recruits' breath-holding.

entities.name: Halimar
entities.description: A region where Zahr Gada leads expeditions.

entities.name: Jaji
entities.description: A magmaw worshipper.

entities.name: Tal Terig
entities.description: Ruins scholars puzzled over for centuries.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: A place associated with the Butcher of Malakir.

entities.name: Vampire families
entities.description: Vampire lineages to whom some humans offered blood hoping to stave off the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Magmaw
entities.description: A creature worshipped by Jaji, for which everything is fuel.

events.summary: Affa changes from a welcoming hub for explorers into a guarded place.
events.quote: Once a welcoming hub for explorers, Affa became a place of guarded tongues and quick defenses.

events.summary: Hedrons coalesce into Eldrazi superstructures, forcing griffins to seek new territory.
events.quote: As the hedrons began to coalesce into colossal Eldrazi superstructures, the griffins were forced to seek new territory

events.summary: Humans offer blood to the vampire families hoping to stave off the Eldrazi.
events.quote: Some humans willingly offered up their blood, hoping it would grant the vampire families the strength to stave off the Eldrazi.

relations.quote: We are losing this war by moments as our goal slips beyond our reach.
